industries.construction.description: Construction robots for demolition, plastering, screeding and heavy work. We cut labor and on-site risk when workers are scarce. Estimate the impact.
industries.construction.name: Construction
industries.construction.lead: Sites are short of workers, and the ones you have cost more every season. Meanwhile, the heaviest and most dangerous jobs, such as demolition, plastering and screeding, are still done by hand.
industries.construction.lead2: Construction robots take on these jobs: they work longer than people, deliver more consistent quality and keep workers out of harm’s way.

industries.construction.directions.items: Remote-controlled robots for demolition and breaking, where it’s dangerous for people. The operator stays outside the zone.
Plastering, painting, skim coating and floor screeding with consistent quality from the first floor to the top.
Moving and placing materials: we take the heaviest work off your crews.
